units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 19a:3">Kidd. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>בנו ד׳ דידיה וכ׳</he> ‘his son’ (<cite ref="Exodus 21:9">Ex. XXI, 9</cite>) means a son like himself (the father), as he (the father) is of age, so must his son (to whom he designates her) be of age.
<cite ref="Shevuot 40b:9">Shebu. 40ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 4b:12">B. Mets. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ דכלים וכ׳</he> under similar conditions as the just stated claim of chattel and landed property.
Meg. 2ᵃ זמניהם ד׳ דזמנם מה וכ׳ z’mannehem (their respective seasons, Esth. IX, 31) is analogous to z’mannam (ib. 27); as z’mannam means two days &c.—
